title: Network dynamics of HFOs (Lin & Stacey; Michigan): filtered and RMS iEEG snippets around interictal HFOs, 2 patients (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG repackaging of the Pennsieve 'Network dynamics of HFOs' release. It contains 80-500 Hz filtered signals and RMS envelopes in snippets around interictal high frequency oscillations (HFOs), plus background snippets, from two epilepsy surgery patients with good and poor outcomes. Per-snippet events, electrode coordinates, and seizure-onset-zone and resection masks are included to support HFO network analysis in refractory epilepsy.
methods_description: Snippets of 1441 samples at 3600 Hz were extracted around HFOs detected on each electrode (up to 500 per electrode file), showing all channels as 80-500 Hz filtered signal with RMS envelope channels. Background non-HFO snippets (500 per patient) are also provided. The original float64 values were written to BrainVision float32 without recomputation, with per-snippet events and electrode coordinates stored in BIDS sidecar files.
